mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hami_gpu_config (id, physical_cluster_id, gpu_type, gpu_mem_mb, gpu_cores, total_vgpu_count, node_selector_key, node_selector_prefix, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{physicalClusterId}, #{gpuType}, #{gpuMemMb}, #{gpuCores}, #{totalVgpuCount}, #{nodeSelectorKey}, #{nodeSelectorPrefix}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE hami_gpu_config SET gpu_type = #{gpuType}, gpu_mem_mb = #{gpuMemMb}, gpu_cores = #{gpuCores}, total_vgpu_count = #{totalVgpuCount}, node_selector_key = #{nodeSelectorKey}, node_selector_prefix = #{nodeSelectorPrefix}, status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM hami_gpu_config WHERE physical_cluster_id = #{physicalClusterId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
